limitations: Build command and symbol listing must come from the same exact recorded build.
Archive names and a handful of symbols cannot prove absence of copied inline, data or merged code.
Independent source-provenance, SDK/DDK rights and corresponding-source review required.

normalization: Only final candidate patch path changes from .scratch location to durable evidence location. Patch bytes/hash and assembled tree are identical; original build used original_lock_sha256. Source directory /work is the container repository mount.
